cv_notice.acknowledgement: I agree to MomentumQuest reading this CV to prepare my application. The CV file will be deleted after processing.
cv_notice.body:
Your CV is read once so that MomentumQuest can suggest the skills, education and experience to put in your application.

The file itself is not kept. It is deleted as soon as it has been read, and no copy is stored. Only the information you review and confirm is saved, and it is saved with the application you submit.

You can edit or remove anything that was read from your CV before you submit. What you confirm is treated as information you have declared, not as verified evidence.
cv_notice.heading: How we use your CV

blocks.text: MomentumQuest is a career and learning support platform that helps students manage their skills, identify skill gaps, obtain learning recommendations, explore job opportunities, submit job applications and track application progress.

This version of the notice (1.1) adds descriptions of two things version 1.0 did not cover: how a CV is processed when you apply for a job, and what is shared with an employer when you submit an application.
Please read this notice before creating your MomentumQuest account.
A. Account and student information

items: account login and authentication information; and
other information you voluntarily provide in your student profile.

blocks.text: B. Academic and skills information

items: completed courses and training programmes; and
other supporting academic or professional information you submit.

blocks.text: C. Career and learning information

items: career interests and interested job titles;

blocks.text: D. Technical information

items: the IP address from which a consent or a sensitive document action was performed, recorded in the privacy audit log so that access to identity-bearing documents can be accounted for.

blocks.text: Verifying qualifications and skills is a core part of what MomentumQuest does. Skill validation, skill-gap analysis and the recommendations built on them depend on evidence you submit.

Consenting to document processing is therefore required to use the student features of MomentumQuest. You are not required to upload any particular document, and you may use the platform without uploading one; but if you choose to submit a certificate or an examination result, it will be processed as described here.
You may withdraw this consent later. Doing so stops MomentumQuest verifying new documents; it does not delete your account.

sections.heading: 3. Document Verification Is a Required Student Function

blocks.text: Certificates, examination results, transcripts and other supporting documents you upload are stored privately. They are never placed in a publicly reachable location and are never served through a public media URL.
Such a document may contain personal information including:

items: other information appearing on the original document.

blocks.text: Authorised MomentumQuest administrators may open these documents when reviewing them for certificate, qualification or skill verification. Every such access is recorded in the privacy audit log.
From a transcript, MomentumQuest extracts your subject codes and grades, and the skills recognised from them. These are stored so that your skills and skill gaps can be calculated.

MomentumQuest does not extract or store your NRIC/MyKad or passport number as a field in your profile or database. Where such a number appears on a document you upload, it remains inside that document and is not copied anywhere else, used for matching or recommendations, written into a filename, placed in a URL, recorded in logs, or disclosed to companies or other students.

A transcript is checked automatically before its skills are used: MomentumQuest confirms that the document reads as an academic transcript and that any matric number on it matches your account. It is not checked by a person, and it is not checked with the issuing university. Skills recognised this way rest on those automatic checks alone.

An administrator reviewing a submitted document checks that the name on it matches your registered name, that it is readable, that the issuing institution is identifiable, and that it supports the qualification or skill you claimed.
A submission is marked Pending, Verified or Rejected. Where a submission is rejected you are given a plain-language reason.

MomentumQuest's verification confirms the submitted document for the purposes of this platform. It is not independent legal identity verification by a government authority. MomentumQuest holds no trusted identity record to compare an identification number against, and therefore does not attempt to verify one.
When you apply for a job you may upload a CV so that MomentumQuest can prepare your application for you.
The CV is read once, in order to suggest the skills, education and experience to include. Reading it requires your consent, which is requested at the moment you upload it.

The CV file itself is not stored. It is written to a temporary location only for as long as it takes to read it, and is deleted immediately afterwards, whether or not reading succeeded. No copy is retained, and the file is never placed in public or permanent storage.
Only the information you then review and confirm is saved, and it is saved as part of the application you submit. You may edit or remove anything before submitting.
Information taken from a CV is treated as information you have declared, not as verified evidence. It is not the same as a certificate an administrator has checked.
Creating a MomentumQuest account does not give any company access to your personal information or your documents.

When you submit an application, the information in that application is shared with the employer concerned for recruitment purposes. That is the information you confirmed at the time of submitting: the skills, education and experience you declared, together with your answers on the application form and any contact details you provided.
The employer sees the application as you submitted it. Changes you make to your profile afterwards do not alter an application already sent.

For each skill in an application the employer is shown whether it was verified by an administrator at the time of submission. The employer receives the verification result only. They do not receive your certificates, your transcripts, your examination results, or any identification number.
Students may access their own account and their own submitted documents, and may not access another student's.
Authorised administrators may access uploaded documents where necessary for verification and authorised system administration. Such access is recorded.
Companies may access the applications submitted to their own job listings. They cannot access your NRIC/MyKad or passport number, your uploaded documents, or any certificate-verification function.

Uploaded documents are stored outside the public media directory, under unpredictable filenames, and are reachable only through an authenticated endpoint that checks on every request that the requester is the owning student or an authorised administrator.
Uploaded files are validated by their actual content, not their filename, and only PDF, JPEG and PNG documents are accepted.

Identification information contained in an uploaded document is not copied into other databases, included in filenames, displayed in public profiles, included in analytics, written to ordinary application logs, sent to employers, or disclosed to other students.
CV files are deleted immediately after they are read. They are never retained.
Transcripts are deleted immediately after they are read, in the same way as CV files. Only the subjects, grades and skills read from them are kept.

Certificates are retained while your account is active and are deleted when the record or the account is deleted. There is no grace period: deleting a certificate removes the stored file as well as the database row.

Consent records are retained as historical evidence of what was agreed to and when. Withdrawing a consent records the withdrawal against the existing record; it does not erase it, because a record that could be erased would not be evidence.
Applications and the information submitted with them are retained for the employer's recruitment purposes.
You may withdraw a consent by contacting the MomentumQuest administrator.

Withdrawing document-verification consent means MomentumQuest will no longer verify new certificates or academic documents for you, and document-verification functions become unavailable. Skills supported only by evidence you have withdrawn or deleted are recalculated.
Withdrawing consent does not delete your account, and does not by itself withdraw applications you have already submitted to employers.
A withdrawn consent cannot authorise any further processing. Past processing that took place while the consent was live remains lawful and its record is kept.
You may contact the MomentumQuest administrator to:

items: request access to your personal information;
report incorrect certificate or skill verification;
ask how your information is being processed;
request deletion of information where applicable;
ask questions about this Privacy Notice.

blocks.text: MomentumQuest may update this Privacy Notice when the system or the handling of personal information changes.

Each version carries a version number and effective date, and your acknowledgement is recorded against the version you accepted. Earlier versions are preserved and earlier acknowledgements are never rewritten to refer to a newer version.
Where a change materially affects how your personal information is processed, you will be asked to acknowledge the new version the next time you use an affected function.

notice.summary:
MomentumQuest processes your personal and academic information to provide skill validation, learning recommendations and job-matching functions.

Documents you submit for verification, such as certificates and examination results, are stored privately and may be opened by authorised administrators to confirm that they belong to you.

When you apply for a job, a CV you upload is read once to prepare your application and then deleted. The information you confirm is stored with the application and shared with that employer.

transcript_notice.acknowledgement: I agree to MomentumQuest reading this document to recognise my skills. I understand the file is deleted immediately afterwards.
transcript_notice.body:
Your transcript is read once, and the file itself is not kept. It is deleted as soon as your subject codes and grades have been read from it, and no copy is stored.

What is kept is the information read from it: your subject codes, your grades, and the skills recognised from them. MomentumQuest never extracts or stores any identification number shown on the document.

Skills are added to your profile immediately. No administrator reads your transcript, and no administrator can: by the time the upload finishes, the document no longer exists.
